game: Al's Garage Band goes on a World Tour

sections.Profile:
Al's Garage Band Goes On a World Tour is a unique pinball machine produced by Alvin G. and Company in December 1992. With a limited production run of just 1,000 units, the game features a fun rock-and-roll theme where players take a garage band on a global tour.
